name: @forgetcase/openapi-core
description: OpenAPI contracts for Forgetcase (common + identity + product domains)

scripts.bundle:domains: mkdir -p src/.bundled && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.json && redocly bundle cases --output src/.bundled/cases.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle cases --output src/.bundled/cases.json && redocly bundle assessments --output src/.bundled/assessments.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle assessments --output src/.bundled/assessments.json && redocly bundle sla --output src/.bundled/sla.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle sla --output src/.bundled/sla.json && redocly bundle fulfilment --output src/.bundled/fulfilment.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle fulfilment --output src/.bundled/fulfilment.json && redocly bundle correspondence --output src/.bundled/correspondence.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle correspondence --output src/.bundled/correspondence.json
